# Report markdown and end-of-run summary show open counts

## What to build

`countBySeverity` in `src/review/report.ts` now counts only findings whose status is not `"fixed"`, and `countFixed(findings)` (same file) returns how many are fixed; the round log line in `src/review/phase.ts` already appends ` (N fixed)`. Bring the two other places that show these counts in line: the report markdown (`renderMarkdown`) appends ` (N fixed)` to its counts line when N > 0, and the end-of-run findings table in `src/ui/Summary.tsx` shows open counts (it uses `countBySeverity`, so check and test it). `renderMarkdown` still lists every finding with its status.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/review/report.ts` — `countBySeverity`, `countFixed`, and `renderMarkdown` (search `export function renderMarkdown`): its counts line is `SEVERITIES.map((s) => `${counts[s]} ${s}`).join(", ")`
- `src/review/report.test.ts` (lines 100–116) — `renderMarkdown` test expecting `"0 blocker, 1 major, 1 minor"`
- `src/ui/Summary.tsx` (lines 25–37) — `findingsTable(reports)` rows from `countBySeverity(r.findings)`
- `src/ui/Summary.test.tsx` — tests of the summary text and Ink render

## Patterns to follow

**Summary table rows:**
```ts
const counts = countBySeverity(r.findings);
return row(REVIEWER_NAME[r.reviewer], SEVERITIES.map((s) => counts[s]));
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/report.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `renderMarkdown`, append `` ` (${fixed} fixed)` `` to the counts line when `countFixed(report.findings) > 0`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/report.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/review/report.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: a `renderMarkdown` test with one open major and one fixed blocker: the counts line reads `0 blocker, 1 major, 0 minor (1 fixed)` and both findings are still listed.

### UPDATE `src/ui/Summary.test.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: a test that a final report whose findings are all fixed shows zeros in the findings table. Change `src/ui/Summary.tsx` only if that test fails.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Report markdown counts line shows open counts and ` (N fixed)` when any are fixed
- [ ] The end-of-run findings table counts only open findings
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/review src/ui`

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/review src/ui
```

Run every command with the graph-execution run variables unset, so the tests never touch a live run:
`env -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUNS_ROOT -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE <command>`.
Stop only processes you started, by PID. Never use `pkill`/`killall` by name or pattern: other agents and graph-execution itself run on this machine.
